name: Swarm Mother

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Inject Poison
abilities.description: A heavy melee attack that does moderate poison damage followed by minor poison damage over time. This can be blocked to stagger the Swarm Mother.

abilities.name: Poisoned Fang
abilities.description: The Swarm Mother jumps on targets that are far away from it, dealing moderate poison damage. Stay near the Swarm Mother to prevent this.

abilities.name: Summon Spiders
abilities.description: Occasionally, the Swarm Mother will summon a group of spiders to attack the party. These should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

abilities.name: Impeding Webs
abilities.description: The Swarm Mother spits a web on top of a player snaring all players within as indicated by a red circle.

related_quests: Deadly Whispers: Aid the Fighters Guild members in clearing the Spindleclutch I caves.
Pledge: Spindleclutch I: Explore Spindleclutch I and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Swarm Mother (set). Swarm Mother is a big spider found inside Spindleclutch I. It is also the namesake of the Swarm Mother set, style, and the basis of a trophy and bust.
